title: Elevator Requests II
summary: All distinct requested floors are requested at time zero. Starting at start, move one floor per second up or down until all are visited. Each request contributes its first-visit time to the penalty; a request at start contributes zero. Choose movement minimizing the sum of those completion times and return that sum.
officialConstraints: Floors1..10^9;1..1500 distinct requested valid floors; start valid.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
